Identified as this saint because: Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), June volume, plate for the 2nd, filed by Commons under Category:Nikephoros I of Constantinople. 2 June is the patriarch Nikephoros the Confessor (758-822), which is the folder's saint - deliberately not the 9 February martyr Nikephoros of Antioch, who has his own plate in the same series.
